title: MPD
description: The mpd module displays information about a running "Music Player Daemon" instance.

placeholders.description: The artist of the current song
The artist of the current album
The album of the current song
The title of the current song
The date of the current song
The current position of the current song. To format as a date/time (see example configuration)
The length of the current song. To format as a date/time (see example configuration)
The position of the current song.
The length of the current queue.
The URI of the song relative to the MPD music directory.
The icon corresponding to the playing or paused status of the player (see state-icons option)
The icon corresponding the "consume" option (see consume-icons option)
The icon corresponding the "random" option (see random-icons option)
The icon corresponding the "repeat" option (see repeat-icons option)
The icon corresponding the "single" option (see single-icons option)

server.label: Server
server.doc: The network address or Unix socket path of the MPD server. If empty, connect to the default host (MPD_HOST).
server.description: The network address or Unix socket path of the MPD server. If empty, connect to the default host (MPD_HOST).

port.label: Port
port.doc: The port MPD listens to. If empty, use the default port (MPD_PORT).
port.description: The port MPD listens to. If empty, use the default port (MPD_PORT).

password.label: Password
password.doc: The password required to connect to the MPD server. If empty, no password is sent to MPD.
password.description: The password required to connect to the MPD server. If empty, no password is sent to MPD.

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in which the connection to the MPD server is retried
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

playing-interval.label: Playing interval
playing-interval.doc: The interval (in milliseconds) in which the playing state is updated.
playing-interval.description: The interval (in milliseconds) in which the playing state is updated.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.doc: The timeout for the connection. Change this if your MPD server has a low connection_timeout setting
timeout.description: The timeout for the connection. Change this if your MPD server has a low connection_timeout setting

unknown-tag.label: Unknown tag
unknown-tag.doc: The text to display when a tag is not present in the current song, but used in format
unknown-tag.description: The text to display when a tag is not present in the current song, but used in format

format.label: What to show
format.doc: Information displayed when a song is playing.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-stopped.label: What to show when stopped
format-stopped.doc: Information displayed when the player is stopped.
format-stopped.description: Information displayed when the player is stopped.

format-paused.label: What to show when paused
format-paused.doc: This format is used when a song is paused.
format-paused.description: This format is used when a song is paused.

format-disconnected.label: What to show when disconnected
format-disconnected.doc: Information displayed when the MPD server can't be reached.
format-disconnected.description: Information displayed when the MPD server can't be reached.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: Tooltip information displayed when connected to MPD.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

tooltip-format-disconnected.label: Tooltip when disconnected
tooltip-format-disconnected.doc: Tooltip information displayed when the MPD server can't be reached.
tooltip-format-disconnected.description: Tooltip information displayed when the MPD server can't be reached.

artist-len.label: Artist len
artist-len.doc: Maximum length of the Artist tag.
artist-len.description: Maximum length of the Artist tag.

album-len.label: Album len
album-len.doc: Maximum length of the Album tag.
album-len.description: Maximum length of the Album tag.

album-artist-len.label: Album artist len
album-artist-len.doc: Maximum length of the Album Artist tag.
album-artist-len.description: Maximum length of the Album Artist tag.

title-len.label: Title len
title-len.doc: Maximum length of the Title tag.
title-len.description: Maximum length of the Title tag.

ellipsis.label: Ellipsis
ellipsis.doc: The string appended to the Artist, Album, Album Artist and Title tags when they are truncated by the corresponding length option (artist-len, album-len, album-artist-len, title-len).
ellipsis.description: The string appended to the Artist, Album, Album Artist and Title tags when they are truncated by the corresponding length option (artist-len, album-len, album-artist-len, title-len).

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments).
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in character the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: The minimum length in characters the module should accept.
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

align.label: Text position
align.doc: The alignment of the label within the module, where 0 is left-aligned and 1 is right-aligned. If the module is rotated, it will follow the flow of the text.
align.description: Where the text sits inside the module: 0 is left, 0.5 is center, 1 is right.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's label, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when clicked on the module.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: Command to execute when middle-clicked on the module using mousewheel.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: Command to execute when you right-click on the module.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

on-scroll-up.label: Scroll up runs
on-scroll-up.doc: Command to execute when scrolling up on the module.
on-scroll-up.description: A command to run when you scroll up over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

on-scroll-down.label: Scroll down runs
on-scroll-down.doc: Command to execute when scrolling down on the module.
on-scroll-down.description: A command to run when you scroll down over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

smooth-scrolling-threshold.label: Scroll sensitivity
smooth-scrolling-threshold.doc: Threshold to be used when scrolling.
smooth-scrolling-threshold.description: How far you must scroll on a touchpad before something happens. Higher means less sensitive.

state-icons.label: State icons
state-icons.doc: Icon to show depending on the play/pause state of the player ({ "playing": "...", "paused": "..." })
state-icons.description: Icon to show depending on the play/pause state of the player ({ "playing": "...", "paused": "..." })

consume-icons.label: Consume icons
consume-icons.doc: Icon to show depending on the "consume" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })
consume-icons.description: Icon to show depending on the "consume" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })

random-icons.label: Random icons
random-icons.doc: Icon to show depending on the "random" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })
random-icons.description: Icon to show depending on the "random" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })

repeat-icons.label: Repeat icons
repeat-icons.doc: Icon to show depending on the "repeat" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })
repeat-icons.description: Icon to show depending on the "repeat" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })

single-icons.label: Single icons
single-icons.doc: Icon to show depending on the "single" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })
single-icons.description: Icon to show depending on the "single" option ({ "on": "...", "off": "..." })

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
